scalars.scalar_value: Graduation from high school AND four years of experience in the installation, maintenance, and repair of commercial or institutional irrigation systems, including at least one year of experience operating a centralized, computerized irrigation control system.

items.item_text: resume
transcripts

01. PLEASE READ THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT: Answer the following questions as truthfully and accurately as possible. You are not expected to answer at the highest level of each of these items to be qualified. The application will be evaluated for minimum qualifications. Your responses to the supplemental questions below may also be used to determine your qualifications beyond the minimum qualification requirements for this classification in a training and experience (T&E) evaluation. Referring to your application/resume, listing "see resume", or incomplete responses will NOT qualify as a response to any question. Questions that are answered in this method will be considered INCOMPLETE and may result in DISQUALIFICATION. You are required to answer ALL of the supplemental questions as truthfully and accurately as possible. Your responses to these questions are subject to verification and may be assessed in subsequent examination parts. All experience, education, training, and certification must be included in your application in order to be considered. Any sign of deliberate misinformation or intentional exaggeration will result in disqualification from this examination process and possible bar from future employment opportunities with the Ventura County Community College District (VCCCD). Select "Yes" if you have read, understood, and agree to the above statements. Select "No" if you have read, understood, and DO NOT agree with the above statements and voluntarily withdraw your application for this position. Options: Yes | No

02. What is your highest level of education? Please Note: Proof of education will be required. Degrees must be earned from an institution of higher learning recognized by the Council for Higher Education. Foreign degrees and credit units require translation and equivalency established by an agency recognized by the Commission on Teacher Credentialing. Options: High School Diploma or GED equivalent | Associate Degree | Bachelor's Degree | Master's Degree | Doctorate Degree | None of the above

03. Have you completed an associate degree or at least 60 semester/90 quarter college units that include coursework in grounds maintenance, horticulture, utility construction, or a related field? Options: Yes | No

04. Which of the following certifications do you currently possess? (Select all that apply.) Options: EPA WaterSense recognized Certified Landscape Irrigation Auditor (CLIA) | Water management or irrigation efficiency certification | Other professional certification directly related to irrigation systems, water management, or landscape irrigation | None of the above

05. If you selected other certification above, please provide the certification title, issuing organization, date obtained, and current status. If you do not possess an applicable certification, please mark N/A.

06. How many years of experience do you possess installing, maintaining, and repairing commercial or institutional irrigation systems? Options: No experience | Less than 1 year | At least 1 year but less than 2 years | At least 2 years but less than 3 years | At least 3 years but less than 4 years | At least 4 years but less than 5 years | 5 or more years

07. How many years of experience do you possess operating a centralized, computerized irrigation control system? Options: No experience | Less than 1 year | At least 1 year but less than 2 years | At least 2 years but less than 3 years | At least 3 years but less than 4 years | At least 4 years but less than 5 years | 5 or more years

08. Do you possess a valid California Driver's License? Options: Yes | No, but I possess a valid Driver's License from another state and am willing to obtain a California Driver's License if selected for the position | No

09. Which of the following irrigation system duties have you performed as part of your work experience? (Select all that apply.) Options: Installing, repairing, or replacing sprinkler heads, control valves, or irrigation lines | Installing, repairing, or replacing water mains or other irrigation infrastructure | Troubleshooting irrigation system failures and determining the source of the problem | Installing or maintaining low-volume/drip irrigation systems | Installing or maintaining flow sensors or flow-sensing devices | Installing or maintaining irrigation communication equipment or remote sensors | Troubleshooting or repairing 2-wire irrigation systems | Performing leak detection and locating irrigation system leaks | Reading and interpreting irrigation plans, blueprints, maps, or as-built drawings | None of the above

10. Describe your experience installing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing commercial or institutional irrigation systems. Please include in your response: a. The organization(s) in which you gained this experience b. The types and size/complexity of irrigation systems you maintained c. The irrigation components and systems you installed, maintained, or repaired d. The types of irrigation problems you were responsible for troubleshooting and resolving e. The tools, equipment, or diagnostic methods you used If you have no such experience, please mark N/A.

11. Which of the following centralized irrigation control functions have you performed as part of your work experience? (Select all that apply.) Options: Operating a centralized computerized irrigation control system | Programming irrigation schedules or zones in a centralized control system | Adjusting irrigation schedules based on evapotranspiration (ET) data | Monitoring system performance through centralized irrigation software | Configuring or troubleshooting central control hardware | Configuring or troubleshooting flow sensing devices | Configuring or troubleshooting remote sensors or communication equipment | Diagnosing abnormal flow, communication failures, or system alerts | Maintaining irrigation system information or data within central control software | None of the above

12. Describe your experience operating, programming, monitoring, and troubleshooting centralized computerized irrigation control systems. Please include in your response: a. The irrigation control system(s) or software you have used b. Your responsibilities for programming and adjusting irrigation schedules c. Your experience using ET data, flow information, weather data, or site conditions to make irrigation adjustments d. Your experience troubleshooting control system hardware, communication equipment, sensors, or system alerts e. Your level of independence in operating and making adjustments to the system If you have no such experience, please mark N/A.

13. Which of the following irrigation water management activities do you have hands-on experience performing? (Select all that apply.) Options: Conducting irrigation water audits | Assessing irrigation zone efficiency or distribution performance | Performing leak detection or investigating abnormal water use | Developing or adjusting irrigation schedules to improve water efficiency | Using evapotranspiration (ET) data to determine irrigation needs | Analyzing soil, plant, site, or weather conditions when determining irrigation needs | Analyzing irrigation system performance or water-use data | Developing recommendations to reduce water use or improve system efficiency | Monitoring progress toward water conservation goals | None of the above

14. Describe your experience evaluating irrigation system performance and water use. Please include in your response: a. The types of irrigation audits, inspections, or analyses you performed b. The information or data you reviewed c. How you identified inefficiencies, leaks, or areas requiring improvement d. Your responsibility for recommending or implementing irrigation adjustments e. Any experience supporting water conservation or water-efficiency goals If you have no such experience, please mark N/A.

15. Which of the following technology, data, or reporting activities have you performed as part of your work experience? (Select all that apply.) Options: Using centralized irrigation control software | Using spreadsheets to track, analyze, or report irrigation or water-use information | Maintaining irrigation or water-use databases | Preparing irrigation performance or water-use reports | Preparing charts, graphs, maps, or statistical summaries | Using GPS devices or electronic locating equipment | Updating irrigation maps, system records, or as-built information | Using electronic diagnostic or monitoring equipment to troubleshoot irrigation systems | None of the above

16. Which of the following tools or equipment have you operated as part of your job duties? (Select all that apply.) Options: Trencher | Backhoe | Loader or skid-steer loader | Forklift | Electromagnetic line locator | GPS equipment | Concrete saw | Jackhammer | Boring equipment | Soil compaction equipment | Pressure washer | Irrigation hand and power tools | None of the above

17. Which of the following training courses or certifications have you completed? (Select all that apply.) Options: Trench and excavation safety | Underground utility locating or excavation safety training | Heavy equipment operator training | Forklift operator training or certification | Hazardous materials or chemical safety training | Power tool or equipment safety training | OSHA workplace safety training | None of the above

18. Candidates who are successful in this examination process may be contacted for future employment opportunities (within this classification) that may be at a different site than where the current vacancy is located. Which locations within VCCCD are you willing to work? (Check all that apply.) You will only be considered for vacancies at locations at which you indicate you are willing to work in response to this question. Options: District Administrative Center (Located in Camarillo) | Moorpark College | Oxnard College | Ventura College

19. Please indicate the type of job (fulltime and/or part-time) AND the type of work (regular and/or temporary) that you are willing to accept. (Check all that apply). You will only be considered for vacancies with the type of job AND work that you are willing to accept. Options: Full-time Job | Part-time Job | Regular/Permanent Work | Temporary Work

20. The testing process will require access to a computer with a camera, microphone, speakers, and a reliable connection to the internet. If you do not have access to one or more of these components and would like to request alternate testing accommodations, please indicate so below. Options: I do NOT have access to one or more of the required components and would like to request alternate testing accommodations. | I have access to ALL of the required components and do not need alternate testing accommodations.
Licenses and Other Requirements:

Graduation from high school AND four years of experience in the installation, maintenance, and repair of commercial or institutional irrigation systems, including at least one year of experience operating a centralized, computerized irrigation control system.

Install, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair irrigation system components including sprinkler heads, control valves, water mains, central control satellites, low-volume irrigation devices, flow sensors, and central control communication equipment. E Operate and program the campus centralized irrigation control system; schedule and adjust water delivery based on evapotranspiration data and site conditions; monitor system performance. E Maintain, troubleshoot, and configure irrigation central control hardware including flow sensing devices, communication equipment, and remote sensors. E Conduct irrigation water audits to assess zone efficiency; develop and monitor irrigation zone schedule; maintain a water use database. E Perform irrigation system inspections and implement leak detection practices to identify irrigation systems and landscape areas requiring improvement to meet campus water conservation goals. E Prepare irrigation reports, including monthly and annual statistical analyses, charts, graphs, and maps; analyze water use data; provide updated irrigation attribute information for As-Built Drawings. E Plan and lay out irrigation systems for designated landscape areas; estimate materials, labor, and subcontractor costs for repair, retrofit, and maintenance projects. E Operate trenchers, backhoes, loaders, forklifts, and skid-steer loaders to excavate for repair and install irrigation infrastructure; form and pour concrete pads for controllers and backflow devices; cut, remove, and patch hardscape surfaces as necessary. E Operate hand tools and equipment including generators, concrete saws, jackhammers, pressure washers, electromagnetic line locators, GPS devices, boring tools, and soil compaction tools. E Maintain an adequate inventory of irrigation equipment and supplies including sprinkler heads, valves, central control satellite components, and related materials. E Provide technical guidance to grounds maintenance personnel and campus staff on irrigation system operation, performance optimization, and water conservation practices. E Assist with grounds maintenance activities as directed. E Work collaboratively and professionally with faculty, staff, students, and stakeholders from diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, and ethnic communities. E Demonstrate cultural humility, sensitivity, and equity-mindedness in working with individuals from diverse communities; model inclusive behaviors; and achieve equity in assignment-related outcomes. E Perform related duties as assigned. E = Essential duties.
